# Reclaim The Net

> A comprehensive resource for digital privacy tools, free speech platforms, and censorship-resistant alternatives to Big Tech services.

Reclaim The Net provides curated guides to privacy-focused and free speech-friendly alternatives across communications, browsing, and social platforms. The site emphasizes digital autonomy, data protection, and resistance to corporate and governmental surveillance.

## Key Topics

- privacy-tools
- digital-privacy
- free-speech-platforms
- censorship-resistance
- end-to-end encryption
- VPN providers
- data-protection
- secure-communication
- Big Tech alternatives
- anti-censorship
- activism
- decentralized platforms
- privacy-recommendations
- first amendment

## Privacy & Security Tools

- [Recommended VPN Providers](https://reclaimthenet.org/recommended-vpns): Guide to privacy-focused VPN providers with protocol comparisons
- [Recommended Private Web Browsers](https://reclaimthenet.org/private-web-browsers): Guide to privacy-focused browsers including Brave and Firefox
- [Recommended Private Search Engines](https://reclaimthenet.org/private-search-engines): Comparison of privacy-respecting search engines vs Google
- [Recommended Private Email Providers](https://reclaimthenet.org/private-email-providers): Recommendations for encrypted email services like ProtonMail

## Secure Communication Platforms

- [Recommended Private Messaging Apps](https://reclaimthenet.org/private-messaging-apps): Guide to encrypted messaging apps with end-to-end encryption
- [Recommended Free Speech Friendly or Privacy-Focused Social Networks](https://reclaimthenet.org/free-speech-friendly-and-privacy-focused-social-networks): Guide to decentralized social networks and censorship-resistant platforms

## Free Speech & Censorship-Resistant Platforms

- [Recommended Free Speech Friendly Video Sharing Platforms](https://reclaimthenet.org/free-speech-friendly-video-sharing-platforms): Recommendations for censorship-resistant video platforms like Rumble

## Activism & Merchandise

- [Reclaim The Net Shop](https://shop.reclaimthenet.org): Official shop for Reclaim The Net merchandise and activism apparel
